The President of the Residual Special Court for Sierra Leone ("Residual Special Court");
RECALLING the Decision of the President on Application for Conditional Early Release
("Decision"), filed on 29 May 2017 1 ;
NOTING that the name of Pro Bono Counsel for Allieu Kondewa, Mr Melron Nicol-Wilson was
omitted on the cover page of the Decision;
PURSUANT to Rule 54(B) of the Rules of Procedure and Evidence of the Residual Special Court
for Sierra Leone,
ORDERS that the cover page of the Decision be amended to include Mr Melron Nicol-Wilson as
Counsel for AIlieu Kondewa and that the amended Decision be treated as authoritative.
Done at The Hague, The Netherlands
This 30 day of May 2017.
Justice Renate Winter
President
1 Prosecutor v. Allieu Kondewa, RSCSL-04-14-ES-858.
